item.description: If you've had a difficult day, this video is for you. Tonight I'll be sharing positive affirmations, encouragement, reassurance, and comforting words to help you relax, unwind, and hopefully get some restful sleep. Whether you're feeling stressed, overwhelmed, anxious, or simply need a reminder that you're doing okay, I hope this video brings you some comfort. If you're watching, listening for background noise, or falling asleep, I hope this helps you unwind and relax. I recommend using headphones while listening, thanks for stopping by :) 🌸Business Email: emily.asmr.business@gmail.com
